guidance:
- Hook style to try: **mistake** angle (1.3x) or **myth_bust** (1.25x) — rotate from overused question/comparison hooks
- Avoid: repeating "same five questions" phrasing (used 11/12 chatbot post), "wrong price" fear hook, generic "robotic" myth — already saturated
- Use carousel format (4x reel earnings per reach) with **self-test-signs** or **bold-slow-reveal** taste
- Post must read as developer showing real work: explain chatbot logic generally, use ONE labelled example conversation, no demo offers
- Include only allowed offer: "pay after approval" + short DM conversation for fit advice

instructions.research: Find 2-3 real Indian small-business chatbot failure patterns (wrong hours, outdated menu, missed WhatsApp lead) from public forums/reviews — no client names, just general patterns
instructions.analysis: Compare last 3 chatbot posts (11/12, 11/17, 11/22): all used question/comparison hooks, all got low engagement. Next must use mistake or myth_bust angle with carousel format
instructions.writer: Write a carousel post: slide 1 = mistake hook ("Most chatbots fail because they're fed outdated info, not because AI is bad"), slides 2-4 = how stale data causes wrong replies (generic examples: clinic timing, cafe menu, gym batch), slide 5 = pay-after-approval + DM for fit check. No niche targeting. Hinglish allowed.
instructions.image: Create 5-slide carousel: desk-glow or silhouette style (top 2 image styles). Slide 1: bold text on dark desk glow. Slides 2-4: simple chat bubbles showing wrong vs right reply (labelled "Example only"). Slide 5: clean text with offer. No logos, no client names.
instructions.video: Skip reel today — carousel earns 4x per reach. If video needed later, use retention-v2 structure but first 3 seconds must show the mistake visually (wrong auto-reply on phone screen), not talking head.

manual_tips: Update Instagram bio to comply: remove niches, region, timeframe, permanent free offer. Example: "AI chatbots, animated ads, lead lists & websites for small businesses across India. Pay after approval. DM for honest fit check."
Comment thoughtfully on 5 posts from Indian small business owners (cafe, clinic, gym, salon, coaching) discussing customer communication pain — no pitching, just empathy/insight
